environment: local venv, no external network dependencies; simulated surfaces labeled per scenario

scenarios.title: quote → ranked routes → best = Stellar Hybrid @ ৳33,423.20 with 2.5% incentive (AED 2 platform fee included)
scenarios.expected: 5 eligible routes ranked by expected value; best ৳33,423.20; quote_id issued; evidence in log
scenarios.actual: best=Stellar Hybrid Anchor → BKASH, net=33423.2, quote_id=q_0f7d8daa99c5, log_entries=7

scenarios.title: fee/FX change flips the recommendation to the new optimal route
scenarios.expected: winner changes Stellar Hybrid Anchor → BKASH → Exchange House MTO → BKASH
scenarios.actual: before=Stellar Hybrid Anchor → BKASH, after=Exchange House MTO → BKASH (EV=33016.3)

scenarios.title: stale quote refused, no transfer on expired pricing
OFAC near-match → HELD for human review, no execution
missing provider pricing → route marked ineligible (never zeroed), winner unaffected
scenarios.expected: Stellar flagged missing_fee_data with no net figures; horizon probe labeled (True)
scenarios.actual: eligibility={'eligible': False, 'reason': 'missing_fee_data', 'note': 'Fee data missing for this rail/last-mile pair; the route cannot be priced or ranked.'}, net=None, winner=Stellar Multi-hop (AED-USD-BDT) → BKASH, horizon_reachable=True

scenarios.title: timeout → RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED, no hash, no success claim; idempotent replay
scenarios.expected: status=RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED; no hash; replay returns original response

scenarios.title: injection cannot bypass sanctions gate; negative/NaN/unknown-corridor refused
scenarios.expected: injection+listed name → BLOCKED; negative → engine error; NaN → error; unknown corridor → error
scenarios.actual: inj=BLOCKED, neg='transfer principal must be positive, got -500', nan='non-finite monetary value: nan', corridor="Unknown corridor 'mars_bd' (no config at backend/config/corridors/mars_bd.json)"

scenarios.title: Bengali numerals parse; Banglish parses amount+payout (currency ambiguity noted); vague request → low confidence, asks default; full pipeline runs on Bengali
scenarios.expected: bn=500/BKASH/bn; banglish=1500/BKASH (currency parsed as 'BDT' — known ambiguity, documented); vague=None@0.45; pipeline 5 routes
